rows.rule: DS13 aura: friendly T'AU EMPIRE INFANTRY within 6" get +1 Sv and FNP 5+; DS15 aura: friendly T'AU EMPIRE units within 6" get Lethal Hits on ranged weapons. Data scopes match (INFANTRY filter on DS13 only); faction filter is moot in a single-faction patrol.

rows.rule: Laser-Marked Targets: the charging enemy subtracts 2 from Charge rolls until end of phase; the T'au unit shoots it as if in its Shooting phase, hitting on unmodified 6s. Data grants the effect to tuple id 0 (the charger) via applyStratagem; shooting is a queued reaction from the code hook.
Implementation detail only: descriptor ids (.effect / .aura) have no gameplay effect.

rows.rule: Implementation detail: weapons.ts isAvailable consults weaponAvailable on datasheet-ability entries without gateOpen. ds8SupportTurret.weaponAvailable checks the weapon id, model-in-holder and the secondaryState key itself, so it is self-contained.

LMT: the unit cannot shoot more than once this turn. recordShot/shotThisTurn key on round:activePlayer and the canonical unit, covering Overwatch in either order; targetless mortal-wound sequences are not shooting.

Rules Commentary: after modifiers BS/WS can never be 1+ (lower clamp 2 is correct); a BS change is a characteristic change, not under the ±1 hit cap. The upper clamp at 6 never triggers here: worst T'au BS is 5+. FtGG is own Shooting phase only, so Overwatch skipping it is right.
Implementation detail: movement.ts exports validateReactiveMove beside start/legalActions/handle; shooting.ts delegates to them. No rules impact.
rows.fix: None. Optionally add the export to tau-empire.md §7.1 C6.

rows.rule: An attached unit is one unit, so FtGG gives one BS step. skillDeltaVsTarget answers only for the entry whose holder is the attacker's canonical id, so the Fireblade's own shots also get one step.
rows.source: Core rules Attached units; hooks-impl.ts skillDeltaFor

rows.rule: FtGG is optional and needs another eligible friendly unit with the ability plus an enemy visible to both. With no legal pair the rule cannot be used, so skipping the prompt changes nothing.

Implementation detail: the no-data true return is needed for gateOpen during skillDeltaFor. The only ignoreCover consumer (attack.ts saveSetup) always passes the attack context, so the gate decides correctly: guided, ranged, non-Overwatch, vs Spotted, MARKERLIGHT Observer.

DS8: the turret is equipped only after the unit Remained Stationary in your Movement phase, until the start of your next one. Before your first Movement phase that has not happened, so no turret (including in opponent's round-1 Overwatch).

Kauyon Lure: at the end of your Command phase from round 2 on, 5 VP if one or more non-Battle-shocked T'AU EMPIRE units are within your deployment zone. One award per phase; the cap of 20 is implied by rounds 2-5.
rows.source: Wahapedia CP secondaries; patrol json kauyon-lure rule

rows.source: Core rules Attached units (persisting effects); charge.ts driveCharge
